'''Skeet''' was the term for a moving object used for target practice, sometimes on board [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]. Skeet packed with explosives was used in a training exercise for [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] on the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] and also as standard practice for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed aboard the ship.
